messages:
sasha: quick heads-up — noticed a 30-40% p95 reg on small-batch inference on prod after the libnvrtc 12.5.1 rollout earlier this morning. p95 jumps from ~18ms -> ~26ms for batch_size=1 on A100.

jorge: ugh. is this matmul related or scheduling?

sasha: looks like kernel selection. nvprof traces show we fall back to matmul_fallback_v2 for tiny shapes. before patch we were using matmul_small_tile optimized kernel.

kevin: any stack traces / kernel names? can you paste the triton log? (:eyes:)

sasha: pasted below — core snippet from triton verbose:
```
[2026-03-18 09:12:03] kernel_selector: selected kernel matmul_fallback_v2 (heuristic score 0.62)
[2026-03-18 09:12:03] matmul_small_tile: unsupported due to nvrtc_query_arch_version mismatch (reported sm=80, expected sm>=86)
```

li: nvrtc bump could have changed reported arch or PTX capabilities we use for kernel gating.

maya: we saw similar behavior in CI smoke on aarch64 tests but assumed noise.

perf-bot: perf-regression-detector: alert triggered on infra-prod/infer-route: p95 +44% on 8/24 clusters.

jorge: can someone reproduce locally with docker image that has libnvrtc 12.5.1? if we can repro we can bisect.

kevin: i pulled the image and ran the small-batch bench. reproduces. p95 26ms. i ran `TRITON_KERNEL_DEBUG=1` to force selection and can flip kernel via env to matmul_small_tile -> p95 back to 17ms.

sasha: exact command to override (for CI/hotfix):
```
export TRITON_FORCE_KERNEL=matmul_small_tile
./run_infer_bench --model llama-small --bs 1 --seq 64
```

li: thanks — that's a workable mitigation until we get a permanent fix. can we bisect which change in nvrtc / pytorch toolchain caused reported arch mismatch? maybe nvrtc started reporting sm differently.

jorge: quick bisect note: narrowing to package update `nvrtc-12.5.1` -> `nvrtc-12.5.0` looks like the delta. i started a git bisect on our kernel gating rules repo to see if we attempted to adapt in the selector to nvrtc-12.5 earlier.

maya: ops: blocking release until we have either a revert or rollout that sets TRITON_FORCE_KERNEL for affected fleets. setting as rollout blocker.

kevin: i'll open a revert PR for the runtime selector change and patch release. linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1234

sasha: filed incident ticket: INC-2026-188 — adding perf graphs and repro steps.

li: next actions: 1) deploy env override to canary (maya) 2) revert selector PR (kevin) 3) investigate nvrtc packaging changes and update selector gating (jorge)

maya: will schedule canary in 30m and notify infra.

perf-bot: note: re-run perf smoke once canary is live. :white_check_mark:

sasha: thanks team — i'll update thread when canary completes (ETA ~45m).
